messages:
sara: heads-up launch posts went live 08:15 PT. GA shows 1.9k sessions but KPI board only lists 72 leads. can someone check attribution? :magnifying_glass:

ben: quick glance - top referrers include t.co and a shortlink domain. shortlinks sometimes drop query params on redirect.

metrics-bot: quick stats: sessions=1897, page_views=1840, form_submits=78, pulse_leads=72. top_referrers: t.co(38%), short.ly(25%), fb.com(15%). last_sync=4823456800.

ivy: if short.ly redirects removed utm, forms may be recorded as direct. we should reprocess leads by joining click logs to recover original URLs.

ben: i'll open a tiny PR to update campaign URLs to preserve querystring on redirect. also adding a preflight step to check final URLs.

metrics-bot: reprocess queued. estimated 6m. will tag any recovered rows with attribution_note="shortlink-utm-loss".

sara: please add a short note to the KPI board so Monday reviewers know counts were backfilled.

metrics-bot: reprocess complete. delta: +95 leads recovered and attributed to campaign=april_launch. pulseboard updated at 4823456839.

ivy: nice. follow-ups: (1) remove short.ly usage for final targets, (2) add attribution_flag column to weekly KPI export.

ben: I'll own shortlink change and deploy PR today. thanks team.
